name: Q2 while is not None loop
code:
class Nd2:
    def __init__(self, v):
        self.v = v
        self.next = None
n1 = Nd2(1)
n2 = Nd2(2)
n1.next = n2
out = []
cur = n1
while cur is not None:
    out.append(cur.v)
    cur = cur.next
print(out)
